description: BASELINE (dsOMOP 2.10.2) canonical STAGED results of safe-class v1 plans with requested roots on admissible fixtures, re-executed by tests/testthat/test-ir-results.R with the current code (review B10, Astra R5).
selection: a .planExecute() or omopPlanExecuteDS() call made directly by a test block of the 2.10.2 dsOMOP suite, in staged mode, with at least one requested root

block class safe in v1-corpus-classes.csv, or corrected by a reviewed correction replayed by test-ir-results.R (.B10_CORRECTIONS; tools/ws2/compare_results.py REVIEWED_CORRECTIONS); a mixed block only with a reviewed attribution of the call to that row (`attribution`; MIXED_ATTRIBUTION)
succeeded at baseline without warnings, with no data frame inside the plan
identical in two independent baseline runs at 17 significant digits (values, raw person tokens); duplicates (same plan, symbols, options, environment) pinned once
admissible: every staged component with a person column holds >= nfilter.subset distinct persons (`support`)

a fixture the replay rebuilds exactly: a fresh create_test_handle() with the recorded rows of every changed table and the recorded non-core handle fields (person key); no TEMP tables, no core field change; the rebuilt content hash must equal `fixture$db_sha256`
options naming a temporary directory of the baseline session (`fresh_tempfile_options`) get a fresh tempfile() in the replay
compared: the complete canonical form of the returned value (.planExecute) or of the assigned bindings (omopPlanExecuteDS): descriptors field by field and the staged file content and byte hash; excluded volatile parts only: staging tokens, the session tempdir and tempfile hex of metadata$file, expires_at; person tokens by linkage plus raw_token_sha256
